by
  let n := fintype.card ι
  let f' : Fin n → Module.Dual K M := ⟨f⟩
  obtain ⟨x, h⟩ := (h (fintype.choose ι 0)).exists
  refine ⟨x, fun i => _⟩
  induction i using fin.induction with i h_i
  case zero => exact h
  case succ =>
    obtain ⟨y, h'⟩ := (h (fintype.choose ι i)).exists
    convert h' using 1
    exact (Module.linear_map.comp (Module.linear_map.mk y) (f i)).apply x
